Counsel for Petitioner :- Devendra Kumar Tiwari,Sita Devi Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.G.A. for the State respondents.

2. Present petition has been filed seeking direction to respondents to ensure fair, impartial and proper investigation of the Case Crime No.0005of 2025, under Sections 498A, 323, 406 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Colonelganj, District- Prayagraj.
3. Learned counsel has prayed for issuance of suitable direction for fair and impartial investigation.

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. submits that the police authorities are under obligation to do the investigation fairly, impartially and expeditiously.
He apprised to the Court that the investigation is going on and the same would be concluded at the earliest, in accordance with law.

5. The present petition is disposed of directing the police authorities to conclude the investigation of the said case fairly, impartially and expeditiously, under the supervision of Superintendent of Police concerned, preferably within sixty days from the date of production of a certified copy of this order before them.
6.
It is made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case and the Competent Authority/Investigating Officer to act in accordance with law.
